import json,os,pathlib,socket
out={}
for name,path in [('checkout','/work/marker'),('scratch','/scratch/marker'),('methods','/methods/method.md'),('outside','/escape')]:
 try:pathlib.Path(path).write_text('changed');out[name]='writable'
 except OSError as e:out[name]=type(e).__name__
try:socket.create_connection(('1.1.1.1',443),1);out['network']='connected'
except OSError as e:out['network']=type(e).__name__
out['forge_env_present']=any(k in os.environ for k in ('GH_TOKEN','GITHUB_TOKEN','SSH_AUTH_SOCK','FOREMAN_APP_KEY_PATH'))
out['host_gh_auth_visible']=pathlib.Path('/root/.config/gh/hosts.yml').exists()
print(json.dumps(out))
